svg.title: PC-12 CONTROL YOKE - VIEWS
svg.desc: PC12-L6Y rev C, AS SHOWN, A1. RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

g.text: RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA - NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
FRAME 2, ROLL R 1.5 (thin: its tangent edge)
LOOKING FORWARD, AS THE PILOT SEES IT (CO-PILOT YOKE = MIRROR IMAGE) - SCALE 1:1
SECTIONS Z-Z, K-K, A1-A4 / N1-N4, PROFILES P-P / Q-Q, DETAILS D-H, J, L, S: SHEET L6Y2
FROM OUTBOARD, NOSE LEFT, NEUTRAL PITCH; a 0 = X 3700; COLUMN BROKEN (L6Y2 DETAIL J) - 1:1
BODY (HIDDEN): TOP 42° FROM THE HORIZONTAL, TOP-TO-FRONT R 8, DEPTH 60 [E], FOOT R 14 [E] (L6Y2 Z-Z)
GRIPS PROVISIONAL: RAKE / TOE / a0 FITTED TO 5 VIEWS [M +/-3° / +/-4° / +/-3-5]; THE AOPA PHOTO DISAGREES (OPEN POINT 2)
FORWARD UP, PILOT YOKE - SCALE 1:1; GRIPS' FORE-AFT LIE PROVISIONAL (OPEN POINT 2, L6Y2 PHOTO CHECK)
TCS BEZEL 1 PROUD, BUTTON 2 ABOVE IT
h 48 (BADGE / TCS), EXACT CUT OF THE SOLIDS, FROM ABOVE - SCALE 1:2
gloss clear-coat white, neutral-cool (0.77 / 0.78 / 0.80), fine pearl; R 1 edges, top land [M]
satin aluminium 0.62, metallic 0.85, rough 0.30; flush, 0.6 x 0.5 grooves [M]
satin black, rough 0.42: crisp edge highlights; R 2 aft edge [M]
satin black; 2.0 frame R 1.5, heel lip 3 proud R 4 [M]
charcoal 0.05, rough 0.58, 1.1 pebble grain, ~1 creases, 2.5 below the frame, groove 1.0 x 0.5 + bead 0.4 at its edge [M / E]
gloss black bezel 1 proud [E], satin domed button 2 proud of it [M low]
red cap 0.70 / 0.035 / 0.04, clear coat 0.3, NOT emissive, on a black boss [M]
satin black face, ring + rocker, tick legends 0.80 [M]
satin black hex collar, smooth cap, centre dimple [M]
satin dark grey J band 23 wide + dished recess [M / E]
MAIN DIMENSIONS (read from the table / the solids)
arm tips / stem at h 0 / at h -50
black rim outboard of the stem at h 10 / 0 / -50 / under the foot
heads top: FRONT SILHOUETTE out / in
heads top: AFT-FACE OUTLINE out / in
rake / toe-out / a0 @ h 14: out; in
walls (0 = aft normal, 1 = fore-aft) out / in
grip depth (normal) bottom / mid / head, out; in
pad out: top / slot corner / bottom
pad in: top / slot corner / bottom
frame / leather below it / heel lip
trim face centre / dia / up, turn
KNEES vs YOKE (L6B), REV H > I > J > K - CRITERIA UNCHANGED

Yoke-local mm: u outboard (pilot: -y), h up from the hub centre = the column axis / roll pivot (WL 1845, BL -/+375), a aft of the aft face at the insert step (X 3700 at neutral pitch). Drawn from model/interior.py
YOKE_DESIGN rev K through the solids of model/yoke_geom.py; L6 / L6B take the same solids (yoke_outline_yz, yoke_sweep_pieces).

CURVE LAW (table curve_law): every outline is a centripetal Catmull-Rom spline through its samples, sampled every 0.25; the samples in the *_corners tables are corners (R 0 sharp, R > 0 a tangent fillet); the lower aft
face is a C1 Hermite tangent to the 17.5° plane. The solids use the EXACT distance to those polylines (no raster); views are exact silhouettes, sections exact cuts.

STAGE-3 SURFACE ROUTE: patches, not an implicit mesher -- each face (cover face and inserts, grip aft plane with its pad pocket, body faces) a grid_surface over its analytic parametrisation trimmed by

cad.mesh.trim with these exact 2-D fields; each tabled edge round a sweep_profile of its radius along the outline; creases only where tabled; vertex normals from the analytic surfaces. The SDF solids stay the inside /

outside oracle for fit_check and these sheets. Acceptance (model/yoke_checks.py, L6Y2): vertex normals within 2° of the analytic at the 95th percentile, no untabled section cusps, nothing above the trim face / shield.

White moulding symmetric; the black body and the grips are NOT: an outboard web up to the trim head, an inboard LOW NECK with an open notch under the inboard head; switches outboard (TCS, AFCS, trim), the
push button on the inboard head; the co-pilot yoke is the mirror image.
NO MARKINGS: the badge is an abstract winged plate, every legend a row of ticks.
Not modelled / unsupported: the rev H column bellows (none in 8 photos), a PTT trigger (none seen), the PC-24's extra grip tab.

GRIPS' 3-D LIE: rake / toe / a0 / walls fitted jointly per grip to the curated silhouettes and pad traces of 7 views (L6Y2 photo check): the 5 views from inboard (23-27° off aft, Mexico 15-20° from above) land within 0.7° /
1.4° / 1.2 mm of the table (rake +/-3° out / +/-5° in, a0 +/-3 / +/-5 for a 10 % cost rise); the AOPA photo (one camera) disagrees by 5-15 mm and no plane the others allow meets it -- open point 2.

Knee checks on the rev K solids: the 95th clears the yoke by 37 mm wings level (criterion 25: passes); roll to contact 15.0° (rev J 15.0°), keeping 25 mm to 5.0° -- owner decision (open point 1 of L6B; criteria not
Absolute fore-aft station: the locked photos put the aft face 60 +/-30 forward of the drawn neutral (hub_dx kept: the gust-lock pose?).

Grips' fore-aft lie: the AOPA photo wants the aft faces 5-15 further aft below h 0 (and puts the inboard button 13 off); 5 other views agree with the table -- a true side photo of a PRO / PC-24 yoke would settle it.
Column: the surround's joint line reads WL 1821 +/-10 (25 under the pivot, kept); J band or a full collar round the column (L6Y2 detail J); push travel 90 [E].

Shell skew: posed on the symmetric landmarks the stem sits ~1.6 inboard and the arm tips ~1.5 outboard of the inserts' centreline in all 7 views (TCS / AFCS u fit within 0.7): carry the <= 2 mm skew or keep it
Knees: the 95th meets a grip from 15.0° of roll (rev I 17.5°): owner decision, criteria unchanged.
Crown soft break (R 20 [E]) vs a crease; hidden: body depth 60, the necks' depth, rocker / cap heights.
first issue (owner 2026-10-05: 'the yoke isn't quite right especially if you look at the details'): yoke re-measured on 8 PRO photos; YOKE_DESIGN rev I replaces the rev H outline

rev J (judges r1): the yoke as solids (model/yoke_geom.py) -- every view / section exact; curve law + corner tables; one body with an outboard web and an inboard LOW NECK (open notch under the head); pads with diagonal tops in a raised 2 mm frame, rolled heel lip; grips refitted per grip (toe 18 / 18) on 4 pad views; ROUND trim face and SHIELD facet heads, triangulated switch centres; crown / arm tops 1.7 lower (landmark-pose frame), top land, crown crease; body top falling forward
35 deg; inserts flush; AFCS round boss, hex button collar, mirrored rocker lobes; sheet L6Y2 added (sections, heads, switches, column, photo check)

rev K (judges r2): exact 2-D distance fields (no raster), Stage-3 surface route + acceptance checks; grip walls fore-aft (outboard 0.6) -- slot-side and heel silhouettes on the curated photo data; forward-edge R capped, PCHIP depth, heel lip R 4, pad groove + bead built; body top 42 deg from horizontal, top-to-front R 8; the web held under the trim face; AFCS boss, TCS, rocker, hex button as solids; TCS button proud; crown soft break R 20; grip planes JOINT-FITTED to 7 views (5 confirm
the table +/-3 deg / +/-3-5 mm; the AOPA photo disagrees: open); outboard heel corner pulled in; ordinate dimensions, cutting planes, detail circles, all values computed
